summary: Validated Iter43-fix24au (LinkedIn redirect_uri bug fix) and Iter43-fix24av (NEW LinkedIn weekly auto-post feature). 18/18 pytest tests in the targeted regression files pass (1 intentionally skipped — the live LLM test is gated by @pytest.mark.slow). Authored an additional E2E pytest file that hits the public URL and exercises the redirect-uri preview endpoint, the tick-now disabled branch, the publish-pending-without-draft branch, and a LIVE generate-draft call against Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM (returned a valid ~1500-char French Liluvine post, persisted in pending_draft as expected). Frontend smoke test confirms the amber redirect-uri banner + computed URI + copy button render correctly in /admin/settings, LinkedIn shows 'Non connecté', and the autopost panel is correctly hidden (expected since OAuth not completed in DB). LinkedIn credentials were restored to client_id=77rg7lu8v2hd3w + secret WPL_AP1...== after tests overwrote them, and autopost config reset (enabled=False, pending_draft cleared).

minor.issue: LLM-side non-determinism — Claude Sonnet 4.5 sometimes generates the post WITHOUT the 3-5 hashtags requested in the default prompt (observed on 1 live call: clean 1500-char French post but zero '#' present). The prompt language is currently 'Inclure 3-5 hashtags...'. Consider rewording to 'IMPÉRATIF: Termine TOUJOURS par 3-5 hashtags...' or post-process to append fallback hashtags if missing. Not a code bug — soft compliance issue.

issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Originates from PortalLayout.jsx around line 558. Not blocking, but pollutes console and could cause hydration mismatches. Likely a <select> rendering custom <option> markup with a <span> inside.

action_items: OPTIONAL: tighten the autopost default prompt to make the hashtag requirement non-negotiable (e.g., 'IMPÉRATIF — termine TOUJOURS par 3 à 5 hashtags...') OR add a server-side post-check that appends fallback hashtags (#LiluvinePro #PharmacieAfrique #DigitalHealth) if the LLM omits them. Optional because the rest of the draft generation flow works.
OPTIONAL: fix the PortalLayout.jsx <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning (line ~558).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/linkedin_autopost.py — clean module; uses Emergent LLM key + emergentintegrations.LlmChat correctly. Good defensive try/excepts.

Tests in tests/test_iter43_fix24au_linkedin.py overwrite the global LinkedIn credentials with placeholder values (linkedin_client_id='fake_cid_for_test') and never restore them after the suite. This caused PROD-like credential loss in the running DB. Recommend a pytest fixture with teardown that snapshots+restores settings.global.linkedin_client_id / _secret. I manually restored them after testing, but the next run will overwrite again.
